# review contract

Contract version: `1.0`

The `review` category defines 3 capabilities: 2 required and 1 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `review.get-review-state` | required | no | `id` | `id`, `state`, `threads` | - | - | Read the automated review state of a change request. |
| `review.list-open-threads` | required | no | `id` | `id`, `threads` | - | - | List currently open (unresolved) automated review comment threads on a change request. |
| `review.request-review` | optional | yes | `id` | `id` | - | - | Request a new automated review pass on a change request. |

## Details

### review.get-review-state

Read the automated review state of a change request.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `state`, `threads`
- Fallback: none

### review.list-open-threads

List currently open (unresolved) automated review comment threads on a change request.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `threads`
- Fallback: none

### review.request-review

Request a new automated review pass on a change request.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: none
